_comment: FIS Mogul Basic Degree of Difficulty, version 2023 updated Nov 2023 (print date 04.11.23). Codes as printed on FIS result PDFs. Composite codes (e.g. 'TST', 'bpp', multi-rotation with grabs) are computed by the ETL only when explicitly listed here; otherwise the DD printed on the PDF is trusted and checked for within-season consistency.
notes: Straight jumps: Single/Double/Triple/Quad/Quint base 0.40/0.53/0.65/0.76/0.86 (M) and +0.10 (W); upright modifiers T -0.02, S -0.02, D/X/Y/M/K +0.01, Z 0 — printed codes like 'TST' are sums that this table does not enumerate.

Every additional rotation beyond the base manoeuvre +0.17; additional grab per extra full rotation +0.02; layout position in full-twisting flips +0.03; additional upright manoeuvres +0.13/0.12/0.11/0.10.
